segments.name: Data centers
segments.description: Designs, builds and operates data centers, selling data center services under IDC service agreements to end user customers and contracting customers.
segments.evidence: Before April 1, 2024, the Company had one operating segment , which is the design, build-out and operation of data centers.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including end user customers and intermediate contracting parties, pay service fees for data center services provided under IDC service agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company defines "end user customers" or "customers" as the end users of the Company's services.

changes.text: In 2024 DayOne was separated from the other operations as its own operating segment and reported in discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: With the reorganization of reporting structure on April 1, 2024, DayOne, the discontinued operation, was then identified as an operating segment in accordance with ASC 280-10-50
